title: Creating a part whose number differs from a stocked part only in case or punctuation is refused naming it
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T1 (active, stocked at this location). DevTools Network open. Pick Category before typing Cost (known pre-existing: Cost first sends calculate-sell-price with an empty category → 400 "Invalid UUID" / "Failed to calculate sell price.").
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory click New Inventory Part; type Description "QA S7 look-alike", Part Number "qapl-t1", pick a Category, type Cost 10.00 and click Save.
  2. Watch the toast for about 3 seconds.
  3. Change Part Number to "QAPLT1" (no hyphen) and click Save.
  4. Change Part Number to "qapl*t1", Save; then "QAPL.T1", Save; then "QAPL T1", Save.
  5. Click Cancel (button_cancel_inventory_part); search the Inventory list for QAPLT1, then go to Parts → Part Library and search QAPLT1.
custom_expected:
1. The create is refused: error toast "QAPL-T1 already exists at this location." naming the stocked number, with the second line "Please try to resolve this."; the dialog stays open with the typed values.
  2. The toast fades after 3 seconds; the dialog is still open.
  3. The same toast "QAPL-T1 already exists at this location." / "Please try to resolve this."; the dialog stays open.
  4. Each save is refused with the same toast naming QAPL-T1; the dialog stays open.
  5. No new part and no new Part Library entry exist for any of the typed variants; only QAPL-T1 is listed.
